info.name: NDVI Changes APIs
info.description:
Postman collection for NDVI change management APIs.

- Get all NDVI changes for a user's village/coupe
- Get single point details
- Update point status + note
- List all NDVI Change tables

All endpoints require JWT authentication (Bearer token or authToken cookie).

request.description:
Returns all NDVI changes for the user's subscribed village/coupe.

Looks up the user's village_name and coupe_name from ndvi_notification_users, then queries all matching NDVI Change tables.

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "pixel_id": "456",
      "NDVI_change": -0.35,
      "change_category": "High Decrease",
      "longitude": "73.123",
      "latitude": "22.456",
      "village": "Dahod",
      "note": null,
      "status": null,
      "table_name": "2025-11-01_Dahod_SF_NDVI_Change"
    }
  ],
  "village_name": "Dahod",
  "coupe_name": "Dahod_SF",
  "total": 1
}

Returns details of a single NDVI change point.

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "pixel_id": "456",
    "NDVI_change": -0.35,
    "change_category": "High Decrease",
    "longitude": "73.123",
    "latitude": "22.456",
    "village": "Dahod",
    "note": "Checked on site",
    "status": "Resolved",
    "division": "Dahod SF",
    "range": "...",
    "round": "...",
    "beat": "..."
  },
  "table_name": "2025-11-01_Dahod_SF_NDVI_Change"
}
